newsitem.title: USA: Clinton says Palestinians must tighten security.
newsitem.headline: Clinton says Palestinians must tighten security.

text.p: President Bill Clinton on Wednesday called the bombing in Jerusalem a barbarous act and said it was essential the Palestinians tighten security to prevent such attacks.

Clinton said he had spoken with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to express his condolences and said a visit to the region by U.S. mediator Dennis Ross was being postponed to allow a period of mourning in Israel.

"Today's bombing by terrorists in Jerusalem is a barbarous act. There is no excuse and there must be no tolerance for this kind of inhumanity," Clinton told reporters at the White House hours after the double bombing in a Jerusalem market that killed 11 victims and two suicide bombers and injured "The slaughter was aimed directly at innocent Israelis and, make no mistake, it was also aimed at the majority of Israelis, Palestinians and Arabs who want a lasting and just peace," he said.

"The only answer can and must be concrete steps by the Palestinian Authority to increase security operations and the strengthening of security cooperation between Palestinians and Israelis," Clinton said.

Ross had been due to leave on Wednesday to meet both Netanyahu and Palestinian President Yasser Arafat after Israelis and Arabs had shown signs of increased willingness to revive stalled Middle East peace talks.
